name: terrazzo-resine-video
description: Vidéo motion design — Système Terrazzo résine (2A Résine x Sherwin-Williams Resuflor)

scripts.render: npm run render:16x9 && npm run render:9x16
scripts.render:16x9: npm run scan && remotion render Formation-16x9 out/formation-16x9.mp4 --concurrency=2 --timeout=240000
scripts.render:9x16: npm run scan && remotion render Formation-9x16 out/formation-9x16.mp4 --concurrency=2 --timeout=240000
scripts.render:anim: remotion render Terrazzo-16x9 out/terrazzo-16x9.mp4 --concurrency=2 --timeout=120000 && remotion render Terrazzo-9x16 out/terrazzo-9x16.mp4 --concurrency=2 --timeout=120000
